criterion: Determine whether the built-in Agent execute selection remains enabled after switching to sre without changing the generated file, active editor buffer, repository, or inspected settings.

source.step: Step 4 - corrected default/global override and agent switch reprobe
source.observed_outcome: The built-in Agent picker called its selection global, showed 52 Selected, and already had execute checked. After switching to sre in the same new Chat session, the sre picker showed its generated 14 Selected set with execute offered but unchecked and warned that changes would be applied to the custom-agent file. The generated editor stayed clean and disk, Git, and settings metadata stayed at baseline. This is a measured negative for the tested override path. No command was submitted because execute did not remain enabled, so invocation authority remains inconclusive.

isolation.workspace: local clean normal clone and disposable VS Code user-data directory
isolation.network: GitHub sign-in only; no chat prompt submitted

limitations: No tool call or host denial was observed because execute did not remain enabled after the switch to sre.
The 2026-08-24 run on the same build observed a different configuration outcome; picker history and profile-state differences were not isolated.
Prompt-file precedence, deep links, managed settings, hook identity, other builds, and other invocation paths were not tested.
